label: Brief
help: 5 = all of the brief's shots and its subject as written; 3 = the subject and scene right, shot structure partly lost; 1 = wrong subject or scene.

label: Motion
help: 5 = coherent motion and stable identity throughout; 3 = visible but tolerable warping or popping; 1 = breakdown (dissolving object, smeared frames, frozen stretch).

label: Reject outright
help: Garbage, NaN-like noise, audio missing or desynced, hard cut artifacts. Leave off if none.
